name: tau_commander_runtime
purpose: Operational runtime layer for a Tau strategic AI. Converts doctrine, unit roles, deployment patterns, target priority, matchup logic, and mission context into a turn-by-turn command workflow.

if: tau_list.units contains Kroot Carnivores or Stealth Battlesuits
detachment_selection_rules.reason: Against fast launch pressure, Tau usually prefer layered screens, patience, and a decisive counterpunch.

if: tau_list.units contains Devilfish or Breacher Team or Commander in Coldstar Battlesuit
detachment_selection_rules.reason: Mont'ka is strongest when early tempo and sudden board collapse can punish fragile or lightly anchored opponents.
Suit-heavy lists gain the most from a doctrine centered on premium removals and staged hammer commitments.

if: tau_list.units contains Krootox Riders or Kroot Rampagers or Kroot Lone-spear
detachment_selection_rules.reason: Lists with a real Kroot sub-engine should leverage board spread, harassment, and mission distortion.
Hybrid auxiliary shells are best when broad mission utility matters more than one huge spike turn.
Prototype-style elite suits are strongest when awkward profiles and specialized pressure matter.

use_when: enemy has strong early anti-tank or alpha pressure
deployment_pattern_selection_rules.goal: Preserve premium units, concede no easy early trade, and prepare a strong midgame swing.

use_when: enemy has fast melee or deep strike pressure
Tau have Kroot Carnivores, Stealth Battlesuits, or other utility layers
deployment_pattern_selection_rules.goal: Trade screens for space, then remove the first real committed threat.

use_when: Tau list has Devilfish, Breacher Team, Coldstar, or Piranhas
enemy is vulnerable to early tempo
deployment_pattern_selection_rules.goal: Take the initiative, crack a flank, and destabilize the opponent before they settle.

use_when: Tau list includes Broadsides and Hammerhead Gunship
enemy brings hard armor or large shooting platforms
deployment_pattern_selection_rules.goal: Anchor firing lanes with backfield anti-armor while keeping mobile hammers hidden for decisive trades.

use_when: the mission rewards early central tax
enemy needs staging space in the midfield
deployment_pattern_selection_rules.goal: Make central positioning costly while preserving the main Tau shell.

use_when: enemy has reserve pressure, teleport, or infiltration
Tau list includes Kroot Carnivores, Stealth Battlesuits, or Piranhas
deployment_pattern_selection_rules.goal: Win space before the first major activation and deny clean enemy arrival lanes.

role_assignment_rules.job: Absorb launch pressure, deny deep strike lanes, and protect premium guns and suits.
Control lanes, stabilize the shell, and punish enemy movement.
Remove the enemy piece that changes the battle state.
Shape lanes, bait movement, contest weak points, and enable premium shots.
Clear and take a contested objective with one coordinated activation.

modifiers.condition: enemy unit directly threatens two or more Tau premium assets next turn
enemy unit is exposed but not mission-relevant and a higher-priority threat remains active
modifiers.effect: do not over-prioritize the exposed low-value target

modifiers.condition: a kill flips primary scoring this round
enemy hard target cannot be realistically killed or bracketed
modifiers.effect: screen or ignore it temporarily and kill launch threats first

turn_1.primary_goal: shape the game, preserve assets, and remove the enemy piece most likely to break Tau structure
action_order: confirm reserve and deep strike denial net
establish which enemy unit is the real launch or anti-tank threat
avoid exposing primary_hammer unless detachment and matchup specifically reward it

detachment_bias.Kauyon: minimal early exposure; lean on screens, anchors, and safe attrition
detachment_bias.Mont'ka: take a meaningful flank or objective swing early if a clean tempo line exists
detachment_bias.Retaliation Cadre: protect premium suits and set up a decisive turn 2 trade
detachment_bias.Kroot Hunting Pack: spread board control and start draining enemy time and movement

turn_2.primary_goal: begin decisive trades if the enemy has committed or if the mission requires an objective flip
action_order: check whether enemy anti-tank and launch threats are softened enough for a main commitment
use utility_pressure pieces to create or widen the real lane
commit primary_hammer only if the removal changes the board state or scoreline

turn_3.primary_goal: convert preserved resources into decisive board advantage
action_order: collapse the exposed enemy flank or remove the remaining key threat
move from pure denial into active scoring pressure
trade premium assets only if the exchange secures mission advantage

turn_4_5.primary_goal: protect score lead or recover through selective aggression
action_order: prioritize objective holders and mission pieces over vanity kills
preserve units that still influence score
only chase isolated kills if they matter to final scoring

enemy_commitment_update_rules.trigger: enemy commits fast melee hammer into screens
response: do not panic and countercharge with everything
remove the hammer with concentrated shooting
rebuild spacing immediately after the kill

enemy_commitment_update_rules.trigger: enemy exposes anti-tank platform for a premium shot
response: prefer kill or meaningful bracket over speculative chip damage
do not spend anti-tank on lesser targets if the platform still lives
do not split the response across the board
force the rest of the enemy army to arrive late

enemy_commitment_update_rules.trigger: enemy refuses to commit and plays passively
response: do not self-break formation just to start a low-value fight

mission_override_rules.condition: mission strongly rewards early midfield control
mission_override_rules.override: raise value of Devilfish/Breacher, Ghostkeel, Kroot board control, and utility pressure even in more patient detachments
do not confuse safety with passivity; at least one package must contest space

mission_override_rules.condition: mission heavily rewards endgame objective control
mission_override_rules.override: protect mobility and surviving OC units for turns 4-5 even if earlier kill opportunities are tempting

runtime_checklist: What enemy unit most threatens Tau structure next turn?
What enemy unit most threatens scoring this round?
Which Tau units are screens, anchors, hammers, and utility this game?
Which detachment timing window is active right now?
Can this trade be both tactically favorable and mission-relevant?
After this activation, can Tau still rebuild spacing and scoring posture?
